column3: Walking on Tiptoes
Do you have a moment?
Hmm? What is it? Even though I finally got in the mood.
We have no choice but to do it... is what you said just now, right?
Yeah! Is there anything wrong with that?
But your legs are shaking.
Gah! T-This is the pre-battle excitement!
Could it be that you think we can't win?
Heh, I'm not going to chicken out after coming so far!
That's what I'm hoping for.
That's an exaggeration...
Hm... I simply gauged your confidence.
Anyway, am I a burden?
Yes.
That's too blunt! Be a little tactful!
There's no need for that, know that I believe in you.
Haha. Well, I guess it's true.
You're indeed a burden, but that's all.
Hm? What do you mean by that?
This level of handicap is perfect.
Don't say I'm a handicap!
...Handicap.
Don't say I'm a handicap!
I'm not like that at all--!
...Besides, it seems like you're pretty confident.
In a match, the one thinking about defeat before it starts is going to lose.
...Kuroneko.
If you lack self-confidence, hide behind me.
O-Okay...
So you 'were' thinking about defeat.
Don't mess with me!
I too, can do things when I need to!
I hope so.
Don't take me for a fool! I've undergone training after all!
I can't lose when we've made it this far!
...Heh, unknowingly your legs stopped shaking.
Eh?
She... did it to calm me down...
...Can you do it?
Ah, yeah... No problem. Let's go, Kuroneko!
...Yes.
I-I can't deny it.
I'll say it now.
W-What is it?
On the battlefield, there is no "good effort", only winners and losers.
It's not "I have to win" or "I want to win". It's "I win". Get it?
Y-Yeah...
I can fight while covering you; we will still win.
W- Where does this self-confidence come from?
I feel pity for your lack of self-confidence.
Ugh...
Because of that, that sister of yours always gets her way.
How pitiful.
Shut up! You're making me lose more confidence!
Well then, should we go?
Y-Yeah!
